evidence.quote: Bittensor is an open network where independent subnets produce digital commodities — compute, inference, storage, prediction — and the chain pays participants in its token, TAO, in proportion to the value they contribute.
Miners produce the commodity, validators score the miners, subnet creators define the incentive mechanism, and stakers back validators with TAO.

notes.zh: 交集：把推理与算力当作子网生产的商品，用链上激励结算——这是「去中心化推理」目前最完整的一份官方机制说明。适用范围：官方文档写的是角色分工（矿工生产、验证者打分、子网创建者定义激励、质押者背书验证者），不构成对产出质量或可靠性的保证。未解决：激励如何分配取决于验证者的打分方式，而各子网机制不同，跨子网不可直接比较；本站不评价任何子网的产出效果，也不收录代币价格与收益。
notes.en: The intersection: treating inference and compute as commodities produced by subnets and settled through on-chain incentives — currently the most complete official account of decentralised inference. Scope: the documentation describes a division of roles (miners produce, validators score, subnet creators define the mechanism, stakers back validators) and does not warrant output quality or reliability. Open: how incentives are distributed depends on how validators score, and mechanisms differ per subnet, so subnets are not directly comparable; this entry does not judge any subnet’s output and records no token price or yield.

specs.结算单位 / settlement: TAO（本站不收录价格与收益）
